modifications: Added an unconditional allow rule for chroot, clone, setns and unshare to support Chromium sandbox construction. All upstream rules and other top-level fields are retained.

The explicit chroot allowance is required with cap-drop ALL: the upstream CAP_SYS_CHROOT-conditioned rule is filtered using the initial container bounding set, before Chromium gains capabilities inside its new user namespace. Kernel capability checks still apply.
maintenance: Review changes against supported Docker runtime defaults when refreshing this pinned profile; do not replace it with an older browser-vendor profile.
